description: Native MCP host verification matrix. Written by `npm run smoke:mcp -- --write-matrix` from synthetic-data runs; consumed by `holoself capabilities --json` (mcp.platforms) and `holoself mcp status`. A platform is reported verified only when every tool passes with server-side audit evidence. Each platform may also carry a session_start_hook record (recorded by hand from a synthetic-data run, see platform-verification.md); `link activate` installs the Holoself SessionStart hook by default only where that record shows result pass, hook_ran and marker_returned.

session_start_hook.evidence: The hooks.json reference bundled in agy 1.5.0 lists a SessionStart event (flat handler list) in <workspace>/.agents/hooks.json whose stdout is JSON {"injectSteps":[{"systemMessage":{...}}]}; workspace hooks load only for trusted folders (agy changelog). Holoself does not install this hook yet.

session_start_hook.invocation: claude -p --output-format json --model haiku --permission-mode dontAsk; one run asked for the synthetic marker and the context receipt
session_start_hook.headless_requirements: None: claude -p loaded .claude/settings.local.json and ran the hook without a trust prompt or extra setting. Interactive sessions were not tested.
session_start_hook.evidence: Hook audit log (HOLOSELF_HOOK_AUDIT_LOG) recorded ok=true with a packet id and receipt; the host reply contained the synthetic marker and the exact receipt hash from the audit line. An earlier run the same day with a shell-expanded $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR command also passed.
session_start_hook.command: holoself context --session-start --budget small --format packet --hook holoself-session-start (project from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR)
session_start_hook.output_limit: Claude Code 2.1.318 persists hook output above 10,000 characters to a file and shows a preview; hook packets are capped at 9,000 bytes

holoself_proposal_create.reason: host did not invoke the server; host reported: Approval required but approval policy is never.

holoself_proposal_preview.reason: requires output of holoself_proposal_create (blocked); server returned error INVALID_ARGUMENT

session_start_hook.evidence: codex features list shows hooks (stable, enabled); project .codex/hooks.json takes a SessionStart event; each hook runs only after the user trusts it (hooks.state.<source>:<event>:<i>:<j>.trusted_hash in ~/.codex/config.toml). Holoself does not write user Codex config, so it does not install this hook.
